title: Work IQ: REST endpoint tools for agents
summary: The briefing distinguishes the roadmap's planned REST endpoint tools from the documented controls for surrounding services. The roadmap facts and spending-policy update call check out; the Work IQ MCP policy path should also name the Registry tab.

claims.claim: Microsoft plans to enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.
claims.quote: Enable agents to use supported REST endpoints as tools through governed Work IQ integrations.
